items.title: 1.1.1.1 What is a Class Diagram? (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of class diagrams (PDF 22-23).

blocks.title: Class diagram
blocks.text: Class diagram ek naqshe jaisa hai jo dikhata hai ke nizam mein cheezein kaise munazzam hain, jaise aap apna kamra munazzam karte hain. Yeh dikhata hai ke har dabbe mein kya hai aur dabbe aapas mein kaise jure hain.

items: Room (kamra): poori jagah jis mein sab kuch hai, class diagram ki main banawat ki tarah.
Box (dabba): kamre ke andar ek container, class ki tarah.
Attributes: har dabbe ki cheezein, jaise ToyBox mein khilone ya BookBox mein kitabein.
Methods: dabba jo kaam kar sakta hai, jaise kholna (open) ya band karna (close).
Khaas dabbe: ToyBox, BookBox aur ClothesBox aam Box class ki khaas qismein hain.

blocks.text: Figure 1.10 mein Room class (name, size) mein Box class (label, contents) hai, aur ToyBox (toys), BookBox (books) aur ClothesBox (clothes) classes us ke neeche Box ki taraf teeron ke saath bani hain, jo dikhata hai ke yeh dabbe ki khaas qismein hain. Class diagram bas yeh dikhane ka tareeqa hai ke nizam ke hisse kaise mil kar kaam karte hain ta ke sab kuch ek nazar mein samajh aa jaye.

blocks.prompt: Kamre ki misal mein class, attribute aur method ka kirdar kaun ada karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Dabba class hai; jo us mein hai (label, khilone, kitabein ya kapre) attributes hain; jo woh kar sakta hai (kholna, band karna) methods hain.

items: Class diagram: attributes aur methods wali classes aur un ke rishte, kamre ke dabbon ki tarah (Fig. 1.10).
ToyBox, BookBox aur ClothesBox aam Box class ki khaas qismein hain.
